title: USDA AD-1047
description: Certification regarding debarment, suspension and other responsibility matters for primary covered transactions. Cover and submission examples are synthetic context.
notes: The pinned DAT and PDF state OMB expiration September 30, 2025; current metadata must be confirmed before production. The source date is preserved rather than silently renewed.
Organization, representative name/title and submission-owned signature/date are supplied as explicit illustrative context. Read-only presentation is not authentication or a signing service.
Date display differs from the DAT MM-DD-YYYY instruction: the library candidate currently displays its ISO JSON/XML date. This presentation difference remains visible for review.

If unable to certify, the source requires an explanation with the proposal/application package. The form XSD has no explanation/attachment field; this package-level instruction is preserved without inventing a new answer field.
risks: Application integration must supply authentic cover/submission context and a mechanism for the explanation when needed; neither is implemented by this definition.
Current OMB validity and source presentation choices require review; agent checks do not establish human acceptance.

The DAT requires clickable USDA complaint-page and mailto links. Their exact destinations are preserved as text in the layout; the current library/SGG description renderer emits plain paragraphs. Clickable links remain an explicit presentation integration gap.
